name: govern_memory
description: Writes temporary candidates, knowledge decisions or handoffs. suggest: kind=memory|rule|relation; memory requires category/content/source. Distill jobs: suggest, then finalize (do not decide early). Include distill_job_id, evidence_basis, verification_outcome and typed verification_refs; runtime derives Answer Gate, only ANSWERED can write truth. Also require assimilation_disposition and assimilation_reason; add/refine/replace require canonical_title and topic_path as whole-name JSON array, NEVER path string. confirm/refine/replace select exact current target_knowledge=[{title,statement,module}] from normal search (title or statement required; module optional); confirm may reuse its unchanged statement. Unresolved targets retain old memory and unfinished work; independent valid points may save. Internal IDs remain compatible for existing callers but must not be requested from users. decide: kind=knowledge, decision=confirm|reject, project_name, candidate_id, explicit disposition. Delete: decision=delete, project_name and exactly one target_knowledge selection; omit candidate_id/knowledge_items. Replacement deletes old current truth, not history. Candidates are not legacy MemoryEntry truth. Evidence basis/ref kind: repository|user_statement|transcript|source_report, NEVER session_exchange. source_report records only what an authenticated source speaker reported, not external current truth or user approval; use exchange_index, digest and speaker role. User refs need exchange_index + returned content_sha256, no transcript locator. Refs accept kind/locator/content_sha256/exchange_index/chunk_index/role, not source/job IDs. handoff requires project_name/task_id/summary/status and distill_job_id for distill work.

arguments.description: Action-specific arguments; project_name is required for project writes.

kind.description: Existing action kind: memory, rule, relation or knowledge.

final_scope_judgment.description: Current Agent's final semantic judgment over actual output titles, bodies and authority. Supply a CandidateVerificationDecision with points, or a map from returned candidate_id to that decision. Never a proof string. Each output needs supported, durable scope_segments covering its exact final title + newline + statement (typed reports also bind rendered authority and native account identity); refine/replace also require update_meaning_judgment naming all exact predecessor statements/target_version values, successor statements and retained conditions/undecided state. Current-Agent manual work requires no background CLI permission or task_model_budget. Runtime source reopening and CAS still apply.

items.description: One verbatim claim segment and its independently judged future use.
items.title: CandidateScopeSegment

anyOf.description:
Whether one whole refine or replace keeps still-applicable meaning.

The selected host executor or the current Agent supplies this judgment.
Runtime code checks that ``successor_statements`` are exactly the output
statements of the whole point, in order, that ``predecessor_statements``
and ``predecessor_versions`` name the exact replaced rows, and that every
named condition and undecided state occurs in those successor statements.
A hash only freezes those bytes. It does not judge preservation, and
neither does keyword overlap or support for each new sentence by itself.
Omitting the judgment is not a claim that no condition applied.
anyOf.title: UpdateMeaningJudgment

report_topic_judgment.description: For decide of an attributed report: judge the actual predecessor/successor topic relationship. Same source account alone never proves same topic; preserve speaker, period and native source identity.
report_topic_judgment.title: ReportTopicJudgment

report_split.description: For decide of a source_report refine/replace: atomically replace one supported account with every independently verified topic output, retaining substantive qualifiers and attribution. Requires matching knowledge_items and final_scope_judgment over every actual output. Not a v7 literal-edit proof.

items.description:
One independent report proposed from a single legacy account.

Account identity is copied from the predecessor at bind time. This proposal
is not admission. A v7 literal-edit proof cannot supply it.

One qualifier the verifier says belongs to a report output.

Unsupported support and independently useful qualifiers must remain in an
output body. A temporary supported qualifier may be omitted. This object
does not upgrade the original point's support.
items.title: ReportQualifier

topic_judgment.description:
Semantic relationship between one stored report title and its successor.

The selected host executor or the current manual Agent supplies this
judgment. Runtime code checks that the named titles are the exact rendered
titles and that the account identity matches. A caller-supplied flag or a
hash of this object is not an unforgeable semantic oracle: the hash only
shows those bytes were the ones judged. Same account, keyword overlap, and
a generated topic id do not authorize a different topic.
topic_judgment.title: ReportTopicJudgment

items.description: Verifier partition of one output's final title, body, and attribution.
items.title: ReportScopeSegment
ReportOutputProposal

items.description:
Original characters absent from every output.

Only temporary context may be listed. A topic, an unsupported qualifier,
or an independently useful qualifier cannot be omitted.
items.title: ReportOmission

project_name.description: Context label returned by the selected job/target.

content.description: The narrow candidate statement, required for memory suggestions.

source.description: Required source explanation for memory suggestions.

distill_job_id.description: Returned job binding; required for distill suggestions.

assimilation_disposition.description: add, refine, confirm, replace, no_write, handoff, defer, conflict or reject.

canonical_title.description: Exact field name for the knowledge title; NOT title.

topic_path.description: JSON array of whole category names; never a path string.

items.description: Integrity reference used by Dream admission, never evidence content.

locator.description: Transient project-relative path, or absolute path under a user-configured evidence.repository_roots entry. Source/session refs use the owning distill job instead of storing a raw locator.
locator.title: Locator

items.title: EvidenceRef

verification_refs.description: Exact typed source references; user statements use kind=user_statement, exchange_index and the returned exchange digest.

target_knowledge.description: Exact old memory text from ordinary search; no user-managed identifiers.
